title: Top K Frequent
statement: Implement `solve(nums, k)`. Return the `k` most frequent integers. Break ties by the smaller integer. Return those `k` integers sorted by frequency descending, then by integer ascending. `k` is at least 1 and no larger than the number of distinct values.
constraints: The smaller integer wins a tie
hints: Count with a dict or Counter.
A heap of size k can keep the best (count, integer) pairs. Sorting the distinct pairs is also fine at this size and makes the tie break obvious.
Sort the winners by (-count, integer) before you return the integers.

approaches.name: Heap of size k
approaches.explanation: A size-k min-heap of counts avoids sorting every distinct value when k is small.

editorial: A size-k min-heap of counts avoids sorting every distinct value when k is small. The tie break has to be in the heap key or in a final sort, or two numbers with the same count come back in an arbitrary order. This function's order is frequency, then the number.
